summary: Create Outbound Delivery with Cold-Chain shipping for biologics
businessObject: Outbound Delivery with Cold-Chain shipping configuration

acceptanceCriteria.text: The user can create an Outbound Delivery from a released Sales Order for a biologics material.
The system automatically assigns a "Cold-Chain" shipping condition to the delivery based on the material's temperature requirements (e.g., 2-8°C, -20°C).
The system requires the user to specify a temperature-controlled shipping method and carrier that is certified for cold-chain transport.
The system blocks picking and packing if the warehouse does not have temperature-controlled storage locations available for the material.
The system prints or attaches a "Temperature-Sensitive" label and handling instructions to the delivery documentation.
The system records the temperature range and duration requirements in the delivery header for carrier visibility.

HP.description: Create Outbound Delivery from released SO with biologics material (2-8°C), verify Cold-Chain shipping condition auto-assigned, specify certified carrier + temp-controlled method, confirm temperature-sensitive label printed, verify temp range recorded in delivery header
Create Outbound Delivery for biologics with -20°C (frozen) temperature requirement, verify different cold-chain shipping condition assigned based on temperature range

AP.description: Create Outbound Delivery for biologics with ultra-cold-chain requirement (-80°C), verify specialized shipping condition and carrier selection

NEG.description: Attempt to create Outbound Delivery with non-certified carrier (no cold-chain certification) — system must reject or warn
Attempt to proceed with delivery when warehouse has no temperature-controlled storage locations available — system must block picking/packing
Attempt to create Outbound Delivery from non-released Sales Order — system must reject
Attempt to create Outbound Delivery with standard (non-cold-chain) shipping method for biologics material — system must reject or warn

ERR.description: Missing Shipping Method (temperature-controlled) — system must prompt user or block save
Missing Carrier specification — system must prompt user or block save
Missing Sales Order Number — system must reject (cannot create delivery without reference)
Temperature-Sensitive label printing fails (printer error, output determination not configured) — system must warn or log error

EDGE.description: Biologics material with borderline temperature requirement (e.g., 15-25°C) — verify correct shipping condition assignment (ambient vs. controlled)
Outbound Delivery for minimum quantity (1 unit) of biologics — verify all cold-chain requirements applied
Multiple line items with different temperature requirements in same Sales Order — verify system handles or blocks mixed-temp delivery creation

input.name: salesOrderNumber
input.label: Shipping / Sales Order
input.validRange: Existing Sales Order in Released status with biologics material

input.name: shippingMethod
input.label: Shipping Conditions / Route
input.validRange: Temperature-controlled shipping methods only (e.g., COLD, FROZ)

input.name: carrier
input.label: Forwarding Agent / Carrier
input.validRange: Carriers certified for cold-chain transport (must have certification flag in vendor master)

autoPopulated.name: coldChainShippingCondition
autoPopulated.label: Shipping Condition
autoPopulated.source: Material Master (MARA-RAUBE or custom Z-field for temp requirements)

autoPopulated.name: temperatureRange
autoPopulated.label: Temperature Range (custom field)
autoPopulated.trigger: Material temperature requirements + Shipping Condition assignment

output.name: coldChainFlag
output.label: Cold-Chain Flag
output.description: Indicator that delivery requires cold-chain handling

output.name: temperatureLabelOutput
output.label: Temperature Label Output
output.description: PDF or printed label with Temperature-Sensitive marking + handling instructions

output.name: deliveryStatus
output.label: Delivery Status
output.description: Initial status after creation (e.g., Not yet picked, Blocked for picking)
